Container.Name: Cloudlog
Container.Overview:
Cloudlog - web-based amateur radio logging application (PHP/MySQL). Log QSOs from any browser, HF to microwave, CAT control, LoTW/eQSL/QRZ/Club Log integration.
Image is built automatically from the official magicbug/Cloudlog source whenever a new release is published.
Requires a separate MySQL or MariaDB container. Create a database and user for Cloudlog, open the WebUI to run the installer, then restart this container once.
Back up your database before updating.
Container.Requires: A MySQL or MariaDB database container (e.g. MariaDB from Community Applications).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Cloudlog web interface.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Cloudlog config. Your config.php and database.php are kept; everything else is refreshed from the image on each start so upgrades apply.

Config.Name: Images
Config.Description: eQSL card images and other stored images.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Optional. Public URL incl. trailing slash (e.g. https://log.example.com/). Written into config.php on each start. Leave blank to manage it yourself.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner UID for writable folders (33 = www-data). Leave as 33 unless you know you need otherwise.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Owner GID for writable folders (33 = www-data).
